scenario.irule: when HTTP_REQUEST { set digest [CRYPTO::hash -alg sha256 hello]; set signature [CRYPTO::sign -alg hmac-sha256 -key secret hello]; set valid [CRYPTO::verify -alg hmac-sha256 -key secret -signature $signature hello]; set invalid [CRYPTO::verify -alg hmac-sha256 -key secret -signature $signature changed]; set keyhex 000102030405060708090a0b0c0d0e0f; set ivhex 101112131415161718191a1b1c1d1e1f; set encrypted [CRYPTO::encrypt -alg aes-128-cbc -keyhex $keyhex -ivhex $ivhex "hello crypto"]; set decrypted [CRYPTO::decrypt -alg aes-128-cbc -keyhex $keyhex -ivhex $ivhex $encrypted]; set derived [CRYPTO::keygen -alg pbkdf2-md5 -len 128 -passphrase pass -salthex 73616c74 -rounds 2]; HTTP::respond 200 content "hash=[b64encode $digest];signature=[b64encode $signature];valid=$valid;invalid=$invalid;plain=$decrypted;derived=[b64encode $derived]" }
